tool_args.rationale: A fine trajectory batch can distinguish the suggested two-layer before–after transfer from stationary saturation models and constrain its dynamics. The existing observations leave that distinction genuinely ambiguous.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a saturating gradient-dependent snapshot model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The seven rows share one horizon and all but two share one gradient, so they do not identify the temporal bridge mechanism or its gradient dependence reliably.

considered_alternatives.option: Beverton–Holt recruitment or bilinear mass action
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The gradient-sensitive observations contradict a gradient-independent recruitment law, while the pilot response is strongly saturating rather than bilinear.
The nuisance measurement would not resolve the mechanism ambiguity.
